review_notes: I read the whole file, the SmallPerturbation lemma `eventually_isFredholm_and_index_eq`, and the Mathlib lemmas `IsLocallyConstant.iff_eventually_eq`, `apply_eq_of_isPreconnected`, `apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace` and `IsPreconnected.constant`. Every proof is already short and follows the stated mathematical idea. The local-constancy proof uses `filter_upwards` on the stability lemma. The preconnected-set version restricts to the subtype and reuses the global result. The `PreconnectedSpace` version is a one-line term. The `Path` and segment versions are `simpa` rewrites of the endpoints and of `lineMap`. I considered replacing the `iff_eventually_eq` and `filter_upwards` block with a term. I also considered using `IsPreconnected.constant` in the `ContinuousOn` theorem. Neither is clearly easier to read, and the `IsPreconnected.constant` route would first need continuity of the index on `s`. I did not flag either. I did not run Lean, so this review rests on reading the source.
